title: carex miliaris f. major
intro: Carex miliaris f. major, commonly known as the large yellow sedge, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that aid in relieving digestive issues, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Carex miliaris f. major include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
